channel.title: DE magazine Deutschland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from DE magazine Deutschland (deutschland.de)

item.title: Leipzig Book Fair 2026: the River Danube meets manga
item.description: 54 countries, one city: Leipzig takes centre stage in the world of literature. In focus: the Danube through the ages. The Manga Comic Con is opening at the same time.

item.title: “Democracy cannot be taken for granted”
item.description: How the association uses its educational activities and argumentation training to strengthen commitment and counter polarisation.

item.title: How much disagreement can a democracy tolerate, Ms Baer?
item.description: Susanne Baer served for twelve years as a Federal Constitutional Court justice. She explains why it functions rather like a seatbelt in a constitutional state.

item.title: World Happiness Report: Finland tops the list – where does Germany stand?
item.description: They seem to have it all figured out. The Finns remain the happiest people in the world. Saunas, ‘sisu’ or self-deprecating humour: what lies behind the Nordic secret to happiness? And how does Germany fare in an international comparison?

item.title: “Germans are like coconuts”
item.description: Hard shell, soft core: how Brittany from the United States and Abdullah from Pakistan experience the German culture of arguing

item.title: Drone defence and bomb disposal: counter-terrorism exercise in Schleswig-Holstein
item.description: How do emergency services in Germany prepare for threat scenarios? The Getex counter-terrorism exercise brings together police forces, the Federal Police and the Bundeswehr - from shooting down drones to defusing bombs.

item.title: Help for Ukrainian war victims: new mobility thanks to prostheses
item.description: They are forging new paths despite severe injuries: how a German company and its Ukrainian partners are responding to the horrors of war.

item.title: Leipzig Book Fair: Huge crowds at the opening
item.description: The Leipzig Book Fair is now open – and visitors are flocking to the halls in large numbers. Due to the high turnout on Saturday, the fair has already stopped selling day tickets.

item.title: Pistorius visits partners in the Indo-Pacific.
item.description: During talks in Japan, Singapore and Australia, discussions are expected to include strengthening their strategic dialogue.

item.title: New trade agreement: EU and Australia aim to reduce dependencies
item.description: US President Trump is alienating allies with tariffs, whilst the EU is committed to free trade and closer ties with its partners. It also intends to cooperate much more closely with Australia.
